info.name: Penn Courses API Documentation [Accounts] User [Accounts] User [PCR] Plots API

params.name: course_code
params.description: The dash-joined department and code of the course you want plots for, e.g. `CIS-120` for CIS-120.

params.name: semester
params.description: Optionally specify the semester of the desired course (defaults to most recent course with the specified course code).

params.name: instructor_ids
params.description: A comma-separated list of instructor IDs with which to filter the sections underlying the returned plots.Note that if only invalid instructor IDs are present, plot response fields will be null or 0.

items.docs: (GET `/api/review/course_plots/{course_code}`) Get all PCR plots for a given course. User authentication required.
